title: LEC: Our Drive
description: An esports hype trailer building anticipation for the LEC Winter Split.
overview: Our Drive captures the ambition and competitive energy that come with the start of a new LEC season. Created as a promotional hype trailer, the film builds toward the return of the league and the rivalries waiting to unfold.

Neon-lit environments, close-up character moments and rapid transitions create a sense of forward motion. Green light and warm flashes of orange tie the sequence together, leading into the League of Legends EMEA Championship reveal.
